title: Uffington White Horse and St George's Dragon Mound

tellings.quote: mound right next to the Uffington white horse known as St. George and the Dragon's Mound, which is the spot where St. George slayed the dragon, right?

plain: Next to the Uffington White Horse, a giant horse figure on a hillside at Uffington in England, there is said to be a mound known as St George and the Dragon's Mound, "the spot where St. George slayed the dragon." A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien told him what the pyramids were really for, tells Michels this as local lore, without naming a source. He brings it up because, to him, the place and its legend may record something real that happened there long ago.
